# Worker Checkpoint Template

Workers must stop and wait for Parent review at each checkpoint. Workers must not commit, push, merge, approve, or broaden scope.

## DESIGN CHECKPOINT

- Files to change:
- Contracts/functions to change:
- Tests expected:
- Forbidden scope avoided:
- Questions or blockers:

## CODE CHECKPOINT

- Files changed:
- New/changed contracts:
- Why each change was necessary:
- Forbidden scope avoided:
- Partial diff summary:
- Questions or blockers:

## TEST CHECKPOINT

- Test files changed:
- Positive cases:
- Negative/fail-closed cases:
- Gaps:
- Commands run:

## VALIDATION CHECKPOINT

- Commands run:
- Exact results:
- Git status:
- Limitations:
- Ready for Parent final diff review: yes/no
